ayahs.3: Aur tujhe kya maloom hai ke woh sabit-shuda kya hai?
ayahs.4: Is khadka dene waalee ko Samood aur Aad ne jhutla diya tha.
ayahs.5: (Jis ke nateeje mein) Samood to be-had khaufnaak (aur oonchi) aawaz se halaak kar diye gaye.
ayahs.6: Aur Aad be-had tez-o-tund hawa se ghaarat kar diye gaye.
ayahs.7: Jise un par lagataar saat raat aur aath din tak (Allah ne) musallat rakha, pas tum dekhte ke yeh log zameen par is tarah gir gaye jaise ke khajoor ke khokhle tane hon.
ayahs.8: Kya un mein se koi bhi tujhe baaqi nazar aa raha hai?
ayahs.9: Firaun aur is se pehle ke log aur jin ki bastiyan ulat di gayin, unhon ne bhi khataayen keen.
ayahs.10: Aur apne Rabb ke Rasool ki nafarmaani ki (bil-aakhir) Allah ne unhein (bhi) zabardast giraft mein le liya.
ayahs.11: Jab paani mein tughyaanee aa gayi to is waqt hum ne tumhein kashti mein chadha liya.
ayahs.12: Taake ise tumhare liye naseehat aur yaadgaar bana dein, aur (taake) yaad rakhne wale kaan ise yaad rakhein.
ayahs.13: Pas jab ke soor mein ek phoonk phoonki jaayegi.
ayahs.14: Aur zameen aur pahaad utha liye jaayenge aur ek hi chot mein reza reza kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.15: Is din ho padne wali (qayamat) ho padegi.
ayahs.16: Aur aasman phat jaayega aur is din bilkul booda ho jaayega.
ayahs.17: Is ke kinaaron par farishte honge, aur tere Parwardigaar ka arsh is din aath (farishte) apne upar uthaaye hue honge.
ayahs.18: Is din tum sab saamne pesh kiye jaaoge, tumhara koi bhed posheeda na rahega.
ayahs.19: So jise is ka naama-e-aamaal is ke daayen haath mein diya jaayega to woh kehne lagega ke lo mera naama-e-aamaal padho.
ayahs.20: Mujhe to kaamil yaqeen tha ke mujhe apna hisaab milna hai.
ayahs.21: Pas woh ek dil-pasand zindagi mein hoga.
ayahs.23: Jis ke mewe jhuke pade honge.
ayahs.24: (Un se kaha jaayega) ke maze se khao, piyo apne un aamaal ke badle jo tum ne guzashtha zamaane mein kiye.
ayahs.25: Lekin jise is (ke aamaal) ki kitab is ke baayen haath mein di jaayegi, woh to kahega ke kaash ke mujhe meri kitab di hi na jaati.
ayahs.26: Aur main jaanta hi na ke hisaab kya hai.
ayahs.27: Kaash! ke maut (mera) kaam hi tamaam kar deti.
ayahs.28: Mere maal ne bhi mujhe kuchh nafa na diya.
ayahs.29: Mera ghalba bhi mujh se jaata raha.
ayahs.30: (Hukm hoga) ise pakad lo phir ise tauq pehna do.
ayahs.31: Phir ise dozakh mein daal do.
ayahs.32: Phir ise aisi zanjeer mein jis ki paimaish sattar haath ki hai jakad do.
ayahs.33: Beshak yeh Allah Azmat wale par imaan na rakhta tha.
ayahs.34: Aur miskeen ke khilaane par raghbat na dilaata tha.
ayahs.35: Pas aaj is ka na koi dost hai.
ayahs.36: Aur na siwaaye peep ke is ki koi ghiza hai.
ayahs.37: Jise gunahgaaron ke siwa koi nahin khaayega.
ayahs.38: Pas mujhe qasam hai un cheezon ki jinhein tum dekhte ho.
ayahs.39: Aur un cheezon ki jinhein tum nahin dekhte.
ayahs.40: Ke beshak yeh (Quran) buzurg Rasool ka qaul hai.
ayahs.41: Yeh kisi shayar ka qaul nahin (afsos) tumhein bahut kam yaqeen hai.
ayahs.42: Aur na kisi kaahin ka qaul hai, (afsos) bahut kam naseehat le rahe ho.
ayahs.43: (Yeh to) Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka utaara hua hai.
ayahs.44: Aur agar yeh hum par koi bhi baat bana leta.
ayahs.45: To albatta hum is ka daahina haath pakad lete.
ayahs.46: Phir is ki shah-rag kaat dete.
ayahs.47: Phir tum mein se koi bhi mujhe is se rokne wala na hota.
ayahs.48: Yaqeenan yeh Quran parhezgaaron ke liye naseehat hai.
ayahs.49: Hamein poori tarah maloom hai ke tum mein se baaz is ke jhutlaane wale hain.
ayahs.50: Beshak (yeh jhutlaana) kaafiron par hasrat hai.
ayahs.51: Aur beshak (bila-shubha) yeh yaqini haq hai.
ayahs.52: Pas tu apne Rabb-e-Azeem ki paaki bayaan kar.
